before.one_line: VLM-driven agent unifying data collection, policy learning and execution; Entangled Action Pairs give self-resetting autonomous collection loops. Reports 25% higher success than baselines on a real long-horizon vanity-table task and 53.7% less human data-collection time.

fields.one_line: VLM agent unifies collection, learning and execution; Entangled Action Pairs enable self-resetting collection. Vanity-table success reaches 30% versus a 5% end-to-end VLA baseline after five rounds (25 percentage points); human collection time falls 53.7%.

evidence: PDF page 8 Figure 4(c), visually inspected: round 5 is 30% for RoboClaw versus 5% for end-to-end VLA Baseline 1, a 25-percentage-point increase (not 25% relative). Baseline 2 is the product of subtask success rates and is about 17%. Figure 4(a) gives baseline human time 2.16 versus 1, so reduction is 1-1/2.16=53.7%. Section 3 defines VLM lifecycle controller and Entangled Action Pairs.

before.one_line: Frozen sim PPO assembly policy plus a real-world image and force residual trained RLPD-style, seeded with the prior's own successes. 95-100% on 10 AutoMate tasks in 0.5 h, with no human in the loop.

fields.one_line: Frozen sim PPO assembly policy plus a real-world image and force residual trained RLPD-style, seeded with 20 successes from the prior. Reaches 95–100% on 10 AutoMate tasks after 0.5 h of residual training per task, without human takeover.

evidence: Sections III-B–E specify simulation PPO base, image/proprioception/force residual, RLPD equal-buffer sampling and 20 successful base-policy seed trajectories. Section IV protocol trains residual 0.5 hours for each task; ten-task success 95–100% matches Figure 4/intro. Clarify per-task training time so the ten-task suite does not imply a combined 30-minute budget; no human takeover during learning is claimed.
